_comment: All garment parameters in one place. Tune these and re-run scripts/generate_garment.py — no code edits needed. Units are Blender metres; the figure is ~1.65m tall.

pallu._comment: shoulder_height must sit AT the blouse top (blouse.bottom_height + blouse.height = 1.22), not above it — higher values leave the pallu floating detached beside the body.

cloth_sim._comment: DISABLED: headless cloth sim silently no-opped and is far too slow on 2 cores. Drape is now procedural (see drape_folds) — deterministic, instant, and visually better. Re-enable only on a stronger machine.

material._color_note: These are LINEAR values, not sRGB hex. Blender converts linear->sRGB for display, so sRGB #A8291F becomes ~[0.39, 0.022, 0.013] here. Entering sRGB values directly renders washed-out/pink.
